programme.title: El Capo

programme.title: El Capo

programme.desc: 'S1/E211'. Rahul is forgiven by the court and he is set free. Shyamala and Preeti decide to take matters into their own hands. Shyamala brings the evidence to prove that Vani is illiterate.

programme.title: Umshado Lento
programme.desc: 'S1/E31'. Lucky accepts Akash's wedding invitation just as Vasundhara's bangle breaks. During the mehndi ceremony, the Thakurs honour Vasundhara, while Mangal continues turning Jayshree against her and Bunny.

programme.title: Umakhwapheni
programme.desc: 'S1/E211'. Radhika meets Gurunath about a business order, and he offers guidance and support. Shanaya grows jealous, while Radhika's kindness earns praise from her colleagues.

programme.title: Impilo Ka Vaidehi
programme.desc: 'S1/E126'. Devansh admits to Janaki that he agreed to marry Shravanti only in the hope that Vaidehi would return. Realising her mistake, Vaidehi feels remorse, while Janaki assures her father the wedding will not take place.

programme.title: Indoni
programme.desc: 'S1/E5'. Amid village life, family worries and marriage talks, tensions rise over smuggled goods and a market scuffle. As Shyama navigates these challenges, her passion for music remains a source of hope.

programme.title: Iqhawekazi Appi
programme.desc: 'S1/E76'. Mani is forced to make amends for her rude remarks, while Arjun surprises everyone by defending his father. Later, Appi appears deep in thought, and Arjun becomes concerned about her.

programme.title: Imfihlakalo
programme.desc: 'S1/E63'. Kabir is torn between loyalty and duty as his mother urges him to save Vikram in exchange for family acceptance. Meanwhile, the case against Vikram strengthens as Veera refuses to give in to pressure.

programme.title: Paaru
programme.desc: 'S2/E97'. Ahilyadevi loses faith in Pritam after the missing money scandal and harshly questions his abilities. Desperate to regain her trust, Pritam searches for a way to repay the lost funds.
